name: com.vass.depth-anything
description: GPU monocular relative depth for Unity. Includes frame-sliced inference, a pinned V2 Small model, GPU normalization and optional mask-aware depth cleanup.

samples.description: Image or webcam input, depth visualization and a displaced mesh. Open DepthDemo.unity.
Optional person depth. Install BodyPix 5.0.0 and import Basic first, then open BodyPixDemo.unity.
